title: Trustees
intro: Toynbee Hall is governed by a Board of Trustees who provide oversight and help ensure the charity fulfils its purpose.

blocks.heading: Governance
paragraphs: Trustees bring experience and expertise to support Toynbee Hall’s mission, strategy and accountability. See the organisation’s current governance information for the latest trustee details.

blocks.heading: Get in touch
paragraphs: For governance enquiries, contact Toynbee Hall through the main contact page.
